job.prompt: Create a cozy top-down fantasy adventure in a woodland village. A village healer needs three magical herbs from the nearby forest. Let me explore the village, talk to the healer, collect the herbs, and return to complete the quest. Include charming buildings, paths, trees, friendly villagers, and colorful environments. No combat.

game_intent.json.original_prompt: Create a cozy top-down fantasy adventure in a woodland village. A village healer needs three magical herbs from the nearby forest. Let me explore the village, talk to the healer, collect the herbs, and return to complete the quest. Include charming buildings, paths, trees, friendly villagers, and colorful environments. No combat.

quests.text: Explore the charming village square and take in the sights.
Speak with Elena the healer to learn about the missing herbs.
Collect the Moonleaf from the nearby forest.
Collect the Sunpetal from the nearby forest.
Collect the Starbloom from the nearby forest.
Return all three magical herbs to Elena in the village.

normalizations.reason: Outdoor return quest uses connected settlement and woodland zones; area portals are forward-only.
